narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, energetic, punchy explainer narrator. Brisk delivery with no long pauses.

buddy.instruct: Casual, cocky, excited friend at a casino. Fast and loud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two sevens. The third one stops one click short.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So close you can almost taste the jackpot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You smack the machine in frustration. Unlucky? Not even close.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You switch machines, and it happens again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So you hit the ATM for another hundred.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two minutes later, it's gone, and your cup is almost empty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the repair guy you walked past earlier unlocks your machine, and you finally see inside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Each reel shows you twelve symbols, but the chip secretly picks from sixty-four hidden spots.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The jackpot seven gets exactly one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The blanks hugging it get a whole dozen, each one landing one click short.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's no glitch. Slot makers map the reels this way on purpose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jackpot odds stay tiny, while near misses get cranked way up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the reels stop beside the seven far more often than pure chance ever would.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your brain files it as almost winning. The machine files it as a loss.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So you pocket your last coin and walk out into the night.

lines.speaker: buddy
lines.text: Come on, come on, come on!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two sevens. The third one stops one click short.
